assertions.source: reporting only the closed form is what produced the retracted single-factor claim

description: What the strict_averaged -> bring_color_weighted p-n flip moves. The canonical ordering p..p n..n carries exactly ONE p-n boundary for every atom, so the flip is a single A-independent factor 1 + 1.4149466e-04 on the closed-form trace ratio, not an accumulating per-bond error; pure-flavour systems are untouched.

data.retracted_claim: an earlier revision called the single A-independent factor a property of the flip; it is a property of closed_form_ratio's adjacent-pair walk over the ordering p..p n..n
